data.narrative:
SemiQon is a Series A quantum computing company that has raised €19.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 peers across quantum computing—3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method here. Using total raised (€19.5M) as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of €39M. This method is grounded in observed progression mechanics between early funding rounds. Peer-median analysis could not be applied; while 6 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3 required). Relying on all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given quantum computing's heterogeneous maturity and capital intensity across different modalities.

The triangulated valuation range is €33M (low) to €45M (high), with a median of €39M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method; the key uncertainty is the appropriateness of the 2.0x multiplier for this specific stage transition in quantum hardware. Sensitivity to capital efficiency, technological differentiation, and the timing of the next funding event will materially influence realized valuation at Series B.
